_note: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for usage windows, soft caps, and reset anchors. NO reset time is hardcoded in policy prose — agents/dispatch run `bin/usage-status.py` (which computes the next reset from this file) and never eyeball a dashboard. Each Claude seat is its OWN rolling window because teamclaude rotates across accounts and tracks per-model caps separately; modeling them as one blob hid real capacity. Null anchors mean 'owner has not set this yet' and usage-status says so instead of guessing. When a plan or window changes, edit ONLY this file. `subscription` links each seat to config/subscriptions.json for traceability; `fable` marks whether the seat can serve Fable (kept in sync with subscriptions grants.fable — doctor.py checks).
limit_determination_order: 1. hard machine signal: a real 429 / usage-limit error recorded by a wrapper into usage-ledger.json (authoritative: seat spent until reset)
2. computed window: usage-status rolls the anchor below forward to the next reset instant
3. owner/manual %: a number the owner notes in usage-ledger.json from the provider UI (fallback only)
LLM estimation of remaining quota is not a source — never guess from token counts.
